bio: Set within 163 acres of lush parkland with the spectacular River Maine flowing through the estate, Galgorm is a truly unique setting to enjoy a sumptuous Afternoon Tea.  In splendid surroundings of the Conservatory you will be treated to a selection of sandwiches, freshly baked scones and delicate miniature desserts served with tea or coffee. With an ever-changing menu inspired by the seasons, Afternoon Tea is a luxurious and elegant experience perfect for every day.  Galgorm is centrally located, close to both Belfast airports and the stunning scenery of the North Antrim Coast.  Afternoon Tea is priced at £43.50pp on weekdays and £45.50pp on weekends. Champagne Afternoon Tea is priced at £58.50pp on weekdays and £60.50pp on weekends.
